positive_snippets:
Awesome place to stay, esp if frequent visits to Medanta Medicity is required (the hospital complex is just 4-5 mins walk away but have to cross a road). I stayed there with my mother for 6 nights.

The hotel is clean and well maintained. There is also a dining and living area just outside the rooms on each floor which can be utilised if required. The staff is friendly and efficient and special mention to Mr Mahesh and Mr Satish at the reception and Mr Rinku who does a good job in overseeing the breakfast buffet in the mornings.

It is located in a completely quiet residential area and there are no shops of any kind nearby except a few pharmacies opposite to Medanta. The food is good and they also allow outside food.

1 Best place for small functions.
2 Great rooms with excellent service
3 Veg hotel good for vegetarian people
4 Hall is great which can have  a gathering of 50 people
5 Kudos to mr sanjay for timely assistance
6 Location is good
Staff is very friendly and  management is the awesome And I feel very better than other hotels. Room service is good.all boys are helpful in any problem So This is the best hotel for stay.
negative_snippets: The hotel was clean, the staff was helpful, and the location was easy to find. My room was comfortable and everything worked well. Good stay overall.
